scope.objective: Find at most one genuinely independent cooperative-driving candidate beyond the separately revised Ghost candidate, without preserving a candidate for quota reasons.
coveredSurfaces: communication loss, latency, message lifecycle, and semantic or task-oriented V2X
intent sharing, maneuver negotiation, cancellation, and implicit action cues
V2V, V2I, and mixed vehicle-infrastructure systems
formal papers, preprints, official code, checkpoints, and datasets available by the cutoff

hardExclusions.reason: This candidate has a separate v14 revision path; no Ghost, cooperative false-positive, provenance-deletion, or repair-routing variant is eligible here.
The v13 revision decision rejected it for functional equivalence to actor-wise harm, welfare, and minimum-disruption constraints without an observed equal-information decision disagreement.
The v13 revision decision rejected dossier advancement until a frozen natural occurrence estimate exists; no new occurrence run was performed here.

sourceAttempts.result: Read the required v13 jury, v13 revision decision, cross-direction routing, direction review, prior candidate pools, and cooperative closure audits.
Used IEEE/ACM DOI records, CVF proceedings, NeurIPS, ICLR, and ETSI/3GPP primary documents.

assetChecks.name: V2X-Cooperative-Perception official implementation

assetChecks.notVerified: No checkpoint was downloaded or hashed, no environment was built, no CARLA route was run, and no deterministic replay or arbitrary temporal-error scheduling interface was demonstrated.

assetChecks.name: V2Xverse and CoDriving
assetChecks.license: No root license detected by the GitHub API in this audit.
assetChecks.verifiedCapability: The fixed README advertises dataset, checkpoints, closed-loop driving, 3D detection, waypoint prediction, and complete training/offline/closed-loop evaluation paths.
assetChecks.notVerified: The stack and checkpoints were not installed, downloaded, hashed, or executed in this audit.

assetChecks.name: MDrive closed-loop benchmark
assetChecks.verifiedCapability: The fixed README exposes 225 scenarios, multiple planner and perception-swap baselines, open-loop evaluation, closed-loop entry points, scenario manifests, and checkpoint destinations.

candidateLedger.title: 固定边际错误负担下的协同错误时间聚集与规划效应
candidateLedger.canonicalClaim: Holding cooperative error type, severity, object exposure, total count, planner, and route prefix fixed, temporal clustering of naturally observed post-fusion error perturbations can change planner outputs or method ordering beyond marginal AP and error counts.
candidateLedger.independenceBoundary: This is post-fusion within-route temporal dependence at fixed realized error marginals. It does not attribute cross-agent covariance to shared training lineage, select receiver-visible objects, condition value on V2U support, or analyze Ghost provenance.
candidateLedger.occurrenceStatus: A direct primary study reports that cooperative error frequency increases near violations, and CooperScene reports time-varying real link impairment. The fixed-marginal causal effect itself has not been measured.
candidateLedger.assetStatus: Official closed-loop code and checkpoints are documented and commit-pinned, but no checkpoint or CARLA route was executed in v14.

candidateLedger.title: 规划承诺后取消消息丢失的不对称后果
candidateLedger.canonicalClaim: Losing a cancellation after physical commitment has a different safety and efficiency consequence from losing an equally sized proposal before commitment.

candidateLedger.title: 车端与路侧冲突证据的同对象反事实决策
candidateLedger.canonicalClaim: For the same object and receiver state, simultaneous V2V and V2I disagreement creates a source-role-specific decision that cannot be represented by confidence, visibility, or generic trust weighting.

candidateLedger.title: 跨版本协同特征的结果兼容包络
candidateLedger.canonicalClaim: A runtime outcome envelope can decide whether two rolling model versions may fuse without pair-specific retraining.

candidateLedger.title: 显式消息与可观察运动确认不一致
candidateLedger.canonicalClaim: A cooperative planner can identify and safely resolve disagreement between an explicit maneuver message and the peer's motion as an implicit acknowledgment channel.

candidateLedger.title: 本地支持条件下协作消息价值的符号翻转
candidateLedger.canonicalClaim: Receiver-local geometric support identifies when the same cooperative object message changes from beneficial to harmful after distance and timing are held fixed.

candidateLedger.title: 共享训练谱系造成的协同共模尾风险
candidateLedger.canonicalClaim: Shared model and data lineage increases cross-agent common-mode tail risk at fixed per-agent marginal accuracy and calibration.

candidateLedger.title: 远端意图掉线后的规划承诺滞回
candidateLedger.canonicalClaim: A planner should retain or release an accepted cooperative maneuver according to a commitment-aware hysteresis rule after remote intent dropout.

candidateLedger.title: 改变当前规划的最小协作消息集
candidateLedger.canonicalClaim: A per-decision counterfactual can recover the minimal received message set necessary for the current plan and use it to schedule future communication.

candidateLedger.title: CPM 分段部分到达下的对象集承诺危害
candidateLedger.canonicalClaim: A planner can enter an unsafe commitment because one CPM generation event is consumed before its segmented object set is complete.

whyIndependent: The treatment is the temporal dependence of post-fusion cooperative errors within one route, not cross-agent covariance or shared-backbone lineage.
The controlled quantity is the entire realized error multiset and planner exposure; marginal AP, total error count, error type, and severity are matched rather than proposed as predictors.
The output is a paired planner-effect and method-ordering audit, not a new selector, fusion network, communication scheduler, Ghost deletion, or receiver-visible non-regression slice.

oldRejectionClosure.explanation: The old causal variable was shared training lineage and cross-agent error covariance at fixed marginal quality. This candidate removes lineage from the claim and tests within-route temporal dependence after fusion. The ASE 2025 primary study directly reports pre-violation concentration of cooperative errors, while CooperScene supplies a separate real mechanism for time-varying link impairment.

No receiver-visible slice or evidence-veto method is claimed. All cooperative error categories remain eligible, and the intervention rearranges matched natural perturbations in time to measure planner effect.
Ghost provenance, single-object deletion, and source-guided repair are excluded. A result supported only by Ghost events fails this candidate.

The prior object concerned clustered uncertainty and release parity. This candidate asks a matched causal planning question on a fixed official closed-loop stack; it still must pass a fresh reproducibility and state-equality gate before any effect claim.

shortlist.claimBoundary: The dossier authorizes a reproducibility and causal-replay study. It does not claim that natural errors are already proven bursty at fixed scene difficulty, that temporal clustering causes violations, or that any official stack has been executed in this audit.

reasons: The new VTC 2026 primary paper closes the old absence of a concrete cancellation lifecycle by implementing a state machine, 100 ms cancellation repetition, Intent confirmation, and natural simulated cancellation events, but it also directly occupies cancellation design and recovery behavior.

The paper does not publish code or evaluate packet-loss-conditioned planner consequences, and the old public-path audits still lack an executable lifecycle-plus-action path. Combining cancellation events from one simulator with packet-loss traces from CooperScene would establish injectability, not natural joint occurrence.

oldRejectionCollision.closureResult: Natural simulated cancellation is newly supported, but packet-loss asymmetry, public execution, and a non-equivalent estimand remain unclosed.

reasons: The ASE 2025 primary study already compares V2V and V2I across fusion schemes and distances and links cooperative errors to online driving violations.

No audited asset provides simultaneous same-object V2V/V2I conflict with source-role exchangeability. Source type remains confounded with geometry, sensing platform, and coverage, so the proposed role-specific decision is not identified beyond confidence, trust, or visibility baselines.

oldRejectionCollision.closureResult: New role-level results improve direct evidence but do not provide the same-object three-arm pairing or an irreducible decision rule; the old identification objection remains.

reasons: PHCP, HEAL, HyDRA from the prior audit, and heterogeneous fusion work directly occupy adaptation and fallback under latent/model mismatch.

An outcome envelope requires pair-level labels and becomes an empirical compatibility matrix; no natural rolling-upgrade trace or version-pair outcome release was found. A schema or manifest still cannot identify latent feature semantics.

oldRejectionCollision.closureResult: No new direct primary trace or independently identifiable semantic estimand closes the old manifest-versus-latent-semantics objection.

reasons: ETSI already treats observed cooperative awareness messages as implicit acknowledgment, and the new cancellation implementation uses a subsequent Intent message as confirmation; explicit and implicit acknowledgment channels are direct protocol priors.

Changing peer motion to test disagreement changes physical dynamics and policy response, while suppressing a message changes information. No common-prefix intervention was found that separates channel substitution from changed world dynamics.

oldRejectionCollision.closureResult: New protocol evidence strengthens occurrence of dual cues but not an unconfounded substitution estimand; the old rejection remains.

reasons: Update the Unseen Only, CoSDH, Where2comm, and Defer to Plan directly condition communication or fusion on local observation, supply-demand, confidence, or planning context.

The rescue found no new dataset that supplies receiver-observable same-object local support, three matched arms, and enough independent sequences for confirmation. A sign-flip slice would therefore repeat the old underpowered V2U proposal or the receiver-visible non-regression slice.

oldRejectionCollision.closureResult: Neither a new independent cohort nor a new non-equivalent estimand was verified.

reasons: The candidate keeps the same causal variable and fixed-marginal claim as the rejected shared-backbone correlation candidate.

RCP-Bench, adversarial consensus work, and the ASE error taxonomy provide corruption and error outcomes but do not expose natural training lineage or an exchangeable model population that isolates lineage at fixed per-agent quality.

oldRejectionCollision.closureResult: No new direct natural lineage evidence was found, and the estimand was not redefined; reject without reopening.

reasons: The hypothesis is functionally identical to the prior remote-intent-dropout candidate and adjacent to bounded disagreement and formal fallback work.

The new cancellation paper handles explicit cancellation, not silent intent dropout after matched commitment; its custom simulator is not public. No new natural dropout-plus-planner ledger was verified.

oldRejectionCollision.closureResult: The old natural-event and executable-path blockers remain.

reasons: Planner-centric object removal, task-aware risk, Defer to Plan, and the prior per-message causal ledger already occupy message-to-plan influence and planner-aware selection.

Using the recovered set for scheduling turns the proposal into another planner-specific selector; no new identification theorem, natural event, or decision consequence beyond existing baselines was found.

oldRejectionCollision.closureResult: The proposed minimal set is an explanatory or scheduling derivative of occupied influence estimands, not a new object.

reasons: The prior standards pool already states the same incomplete-object-set planning claim for segmented CPMs.
The rescue found standards semantics and codec paths but no natural partial-generation delivery trace with a paired planner action; implementing a segment drop would prove testability only.

oldRejectionCollision.closureResult: No new natural event or planner consequence closes the prior injectability and action-path objections.

conclusion: One narrow candidate survives to a pre-review dossier: the planner effect of temporal dependence in post-fusion cooperative errors under fixed realized error marginals. It is independent of Ghost provenance and of the rejected shared-backbone lineage claim, but it remains unexecuted and must pass asset, deterministic replay, natural-signal, and matched-intervention gates before any empirical claim. Nine other candidates are rejected because new evidence either directly occupies the proposed function or fails to close the exact natural-event, identification, or public-execution reason recorded in prior cooperative audits.
